sentences.en: The big ugly tree destroys the beauty of the house.
sentences.zh: 那棵丑陋的大树破坏了房子的美感。

sentences.en: Between ourselves, the fat ugly witch is on a diet.
sentences.zh: 说句实话，那个胖胖的丑陋女巫正在节食。

sentences.en: The architecture in this part of the city is ugly.
sentences.zh: 这座城市这一部分的建筑很丑。

senses.zh: 难看的,丑陋的,有敌意的,不祥的n.丑陋的人（东西）
